title: Stained Glass Drive
description: A vertically oriented arched stained glass window design featuring a spiraling multi-level highway wrapped around a central pole. Blue vintage cars drive along the elevated roads while a McDonald's cup with fries and the word DRIVE appear prominently. At the top sits an ornate building resembling the Sacré-Cœur under a radiating blue sunburst sky with white flowers.
prompt: A tall arched stained glass window with black leading lines on a dark background. The design shows a spiraling multi-level highway wrapped around a central column with blue vintage cars driving on different tiers. A giant McDonald's drink cup with fries stands on the highway. At the top is an ornate white building resembling Sacré-Cœur Basilica against a blue sunburst sky with white flowers scattered throughout the composition.
